nodes.name: armors.json
nodes.summary: Armor set definitions for all armor pieces in Voxel Blade. Each entry includes name, shared stats (upgrade level, stat bonuses, associated perk), and parts (helmet, chestplate, leggings) with descriptions.

nodes.name: blades.json
nodes.summary: Blade weapon data for all blade types. Each entry includes tier, attack speed, stat scaling values, damage types, associated perks, and blade category (Medium/Small/Heavy/Hammer Head).

nodes.name: enchantments.json
nodes.summary: Enchantment definitions for weapons and armor. Each entry includes name, category (unAscended/Ascended), stacking behavior, stat modifiers (multiplier/addition for various stats), and optional effects (perk grants).

nodes.name: essences.json
nodes.summary: Essence weapon component data for all essence types. Each entry includes tier, attack speed, stat scaling values, damage types, and associated perks. Mirrors blade.json structure for the essence weapon slot.

nodes.name: gloves.json
nodes.summary: Monk glove weapon data for all glove types. Each entry includes tier, attack speed, stat scaling, damage types, and spirit/perk associations. Includes both Gloves and Shield types.

nodes.name: guilds.json
nodes.summary: Guild rank definitions for all guilds (Gladiator, Cursed, Cleric, Scholar, Knight, Thief, Draconic, Monk, Vampire). Each rank provides stat bonuses and perk grants.

nodes.name: handles.json
nodes.summary: Handle weapon component data for all handle types. Each entry includes tier, attack speed, stat scaling values, handle type category (Medium/Long/Pole), and associated perks.

nodes.name: perks.json
nodes.summary: Master perk definitions for Voxel Blade. Each entry includes perk name, description text, and categorization tags (Offensive, Defensive, Buff, Debuff, etc.). Comprehensive reference of all game perks.
